source_notes.scope: London-only research candidates for architecture and built-environment events, roughly 2008-2026.
source_notes.method: Reviewed existing data/manual_drops/architecture_milestones/architecture_milestones_2008_2026.json for duplicate London titles/record ids, then selected public web sources with preference for institutional, London City Hall, borough, operator, architect or NLA/RIBA-adjacent evidence.
source_notes.license_note: Candidate file stores small factual metadata and URLs only. Source page terms and image/text reuse rights were not cleared.
source_notes.date_caveat: Some candidates are month-level or year-level where the reviewed source did not expose an exact opening day. The status_date_basis field preserves this distinction.
source_notes.geocode_caveat: Coordinates are approximate point markers for research triage unless explicitly noted as taken from a source page. They are not parcel boundaries or measured building footprints.
source_notes.duplicate_check_caveat: Duplicate checks used text searches against the current architecture milestone file. Similar broader regeneration projects may exist under different names and should be checked again before ingestion.
